label: Vocabulary-independent physical-ground declaration blocked by specification semantics
summary: Owner approved preserving both naming and definability siblings. Implemented Mathlib first-order syntax and full-domain denotation, ordinary-symbol sublanguage restriction and permitted-parameter subtypes. Local definite description forbids all parameters and has no admitted individual constants. Uniform definability checks a single formula over a nonempty supplied class. Bool marker-inversion proves a local description need not uniformly define the fixed singleton across the class; it does not equate different ontological targets. Permitted-parameter success and emptiness of the forbidden-parameter syntax subtype are separate. A separately empty composition assignment coexists with local naming; no existing ground model is calibrated. Rejected shortcuts from the prior audit remain rejected: flags, composite definitions, opaque aliases, arbitrary names and finite toy physics. Reused the same Mathlib semantics as TruthCore.Logic.ReferenceAnchor and its interpretation-transport method. Definitions and siblings persist in DISAMB-PHYSICAL-GROUND and specs/physical-ground-specification.toml. No source claims or old bindings changed. Extended approved FO/richer and fixed/varying alternatives with restricted FO plus reflexive finite-path syntax (ordinary binary edges; permitted variable endpoints), indexed full-domain definability, explicit target correspondence and constant-carrier specialization. Shared-profile FO embedding is one-way only; strict expressive separation remains unproved. Nat-successor and Bool-inequality full-domain reachability uses one formula and one permitted anchor across genuinely different domains. Unit/Bool equality nonvacuity, anchor-respecting correspondence success and universal-correspondence failure use one common profile. Reachability allows two edges without a direct edge; edgeless graphs cannot connect distinct objects. An independent empty composition/intellect assignment coexists with this candidate specification, testing syntactic independence only, not the actual root premise. Rejected arbitrary names, outcome-coded atoms, empty admitted classes, index-dependent formulas and implicit identical carriers.
blocker: Original PHYSICAL_OF_A_GROUND_2 remains OPEN: ordinary-vocabulary calibration must exclude disguised names; specify admissible relation interpretations and parameters for actual grounds, target transport/correspondence adequacy, and occurrence/property-to-bearer passage. Owner approved both FO/richer and fixed/varying alternatives; that choice is no longer blocked. Candidate bodies and comparisons do not complete the original or remove its allowance. The root-route step STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL is not refuted: candidate-language controls are not mapped to its existing ground/intellect meanings. Next slice: transport restricted reachability under structure-preserving cross-domain maps, test totality/coverage of selected correspondences and connect a calibrated same-ground profile to PhysicalBearersComposite as an explicit premise. Strict FO versus reachability expressive separation also remains unverified.
